name: Sable Luxe Second-Skin Thermal
description:
An ultra-premium base layer so thin it is functionally invisible under any garment. The fabric uses body-heat-responsive microcapsules that provide thermal regulation across a comfortable range while adding zero visual bulk. The material feels like wearing nothing at all — which is the entire point.

Designed for Spire residents who refuse to look layered. The Second-Skin allows them to dress in single-layer garments year-round while the invisible thermal layer handles temperature management. It costs what a Shelf worker earns in a month, for the privilege of looking like you're wearing less.
functionality: Invisible thermoregulation, zero-bulk profile, year-round comfort
what_it_says: You paid a premium to look like you're not wearing a base layer, because visible effort is beneath your aesthetic.
story_hooks: A Sable Luxe Second-Skin is found in a Shelf district laundry — either stolen, lost, or deliberately placed there by someone from the Spire who didn't want to be seen discarding it.
related_entities: Crucible Industries Ceramic Stiletto CS-4 'Phantom Needle'

physical_description.visual_profile: Invisible or near-invisible when worn under other garments; creates an seamless, single-layer aesthetic. On bare skin, a barely-perceptible iridescent shimmer catches light. The wearer appears unencumbered, luxuriously minimal.
physical_description.fit: Second-skin compression — hugs the body without restriction, moving with muscle and breath. So close to the skin it's almost like wearing nothing.
physical_description.primary_material: Synthetic microfiber composite with embedded phase-change microcapsules; treated with anti-friction nano-coating for weightless feel
physical_description.texture: Silky-smooth, almost frictionless against skin. Micro-thin but resilient. No visible weave or pattern — optical transparency achieved through material science.
physical_description.color_scheme: Colorless/translucent with faint iridescent shift (silver-to-violet) visible only at oblique angles or under direct light. Base option in 'Transparency' with premium finishes in 'Platinum Whisper' and 'Void Black' (darker version with same invisibility effect).
physical_description.closures: None — full-body slip-on like a second skin. Friction-fit design; stays in place through micro-adhesive properties without visible seams.
distinctive_features: Thermochromic microcapsules activate only at temperature extremes; invisible during normal wear
Seamless construction — no visible seams or tags
Sable Luxe holographic security thread woven into hemline (visible only under UV inspection)
Self-repairing nano-fiber matrix; micro-tears seal within 48 hours
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury — status object disguised as invisibility. Cost exceeds monthly wages for Tier 3 workers.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by Spire residents and corpo elite who view layering as unsophisticated. Signals wealth through the ability to spend extravagantly on something nobody will see. Rejection of 'visual noise' — a statement that you're so secure in your position you don't need to show it.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always pristine when worn; the self-repairing matrix keeps it in factory condition indefinitely. Occasionally shows micro-iridescent shimmer if worn over sheer garments or under strong light.

image_prompt: Ultra-luxury fashion photography: bare-skinned androgynous model with high cheekbones and augmented biophotonic eyes, posed against floor-to-ceiling rain-slicked window of a Spire tower at night. The model's skin has an almost imperceptible silvery shimmer — the Sable Luxe Second-Skin visible only as a ghost of iridescence. Moody blue-and-violet neon from the Great Lakes Metropolitan Zone sprawls behind them. Minimalist composition. Dramatic side-lighting creates micro-reflections across the nearly-invisible fabric. Close-up detail shot of the neckline shows absolute seamlessness. Product photography aesthetic meets high-fashion editorial. Dark, luxurious, almost alien. --ar 2:3 --v 6
